scope: REQUIREMENTS.md Part A §5-9: handoff/compaction/adoption signal, journal and session lifecycle, notify, display renderer (S1/S2), agent-dir resolution (U2) (packages/nana-pack) — 33 off-form origins split per design-ruling.md §2
notes: Astra r1 BLOCK 6/10 on the first build (17 PINS/3 PARTIAL, two rejected merges, one lost IF condition, four code-read PARTIALs, five standalone-sentence SHOULDs). Every fix below was re-verified by an EXECUTED mutation in a disposable copy (git-reverted after each run), per the seat's tightened rule: an implemented split row's mapping entry now carries a `mutations` array (file/break/cite/result), and apply-batch.mjs mechanically refuses any implemented clause lacking at least one `result: "red"` entry whose `cite` is one of the clause's own citations (gated behind this batch's `mutationRecords: true`, so batch-a1.json needs no retrofit). Both merges (R-142, R-193) are REJECTED per astra and split into two rows each, adding 2 more new rows than A2's original cut (35 instead of 33); the off-form reduction is unchanged (33 origins resolved, 157→124) since a split row is on-form exactly like a merged one. R-803 regains its governing IF condition ("the path cannot be addressed as written"), dropped by mistake when its text was trimmed. R-796/R-806/R-812/R-816 gained astra-named citations with their own executed mutations. R-807, R-825, R-827 and R-193's own "shall not be read" clause are downgraded from implemented to untested: each had an executed mutation (astra's, independently re-run here) that left every existing cited assertion green, confirming no test in this repo currently pins that exact promise. R-807, R-811, R-816, R-825, R-826, R-827, R-829 are reworded to name their own input, condition and object rather than refer back to a sibling row ("any other value", "that name", "a hung one", "otherwise", "the handler").
